name: popover
title: Popover
description: A popover that springs out of its trigger, or morphs the trigger button itself into the panel.

useCases: Small anchored panels such as display settings, filters, or share options, and a feedback button that opens into a short form in place.
limitations: Morph panels open over the trigger instead of beside it, wrap the popover in an inline-flex box, support only top and bottom sides, and never flip or shift to stay in the viewport. The morph trigger is a 36 pixel pill.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Base UI, and theme colors. Give the panel a PopoverTitle or aria-label. Controlled usage requires updating open in onOpenChange. Reduced motion opens and closes the panel instantly without the morph.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/popover.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
